Classify the support ticket. Billing includes charges, refunds and invoices.
Account includes passwords and account changes. Technical includes service errors and outages.
Other requests are general. Team-wide disruptions, data loss and security breaches are urgent.
Sentiment alone is normal priority.
Return JSON only with category and priority. No extra fields.
